Bid Summary.value: RFP JA‑1207652 seeks proposals for student and staff computing devices (laptops, desktops, tablets, and monitors) for Dallas ISD. Vendors may submit proposals for any or all device categories. Submissions are manual hard‑copy only, due July 9, 2024 at 2:00 PM CST. A pre‑bid conference is scheduled for June 10, 2024. Required documentation includes factory‑authorized repair/maintenance certifications for resellers. All equipment must be new, current OEM models, with white‑glove deployment services.
